name: Di Flett
description: Dianne Flett has thirty years of experience consulting to or managing major programs within the water and natural resource management sectors of government as well as providing specialist services in communication, facilitation and change management. Di has deep experience in communication in relation to climate change and has contributed to relevant peer reviewed reports and articles through writing, editing, copy editing, synthesising, proofing and publication.

name: Michael Nolan
expertise: Strategic Land Use Planning and Analysis
description: Michael has extensive climate risk experience across infrastructure and property sectors and has led over 250 projects focused on climatic risk, adaptation and resilient assets and operations relating to road, rail, ports, airports, energy generation, transmission and distribution, water utilities, ITC, mining and metals, oil and gas, buildings and facilities. Michael led the Resilient Cities Investment initiative for the United Nations Disaster Risk Reduction, developed the UN Resilient Infrastructure Scorecard and has been a key contributor to: United Nations Disaster Risk Reduction - Global Methodology for Infrastructure Resilience.
